# Verbs and flags ADR 0003 specifies that NO story has implemented yet
# (issue #155 §5). Same format as cli-surface.txt.
#
# tests/cli_surface_test.rs asserts every line here does NOT parse — so when
# the owning story lands its verb, the test fails until the line is moved to
# cli-surface.txt. The docs doc-test (tests/docs_cli_test.rs) tolerates a
# documented command whose leaf path is listed here, and nowhere else.
#
# Each line names its story.

# #508/#509 (remote hub-admin client, epic #506) AC 9: `--server <URL>` on
# each of the seven admin-eligible verbs. Move each line to cli-surface.txt
# once `crates/holler-cli/src/cli.rs` adds `--server`.
roster | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net --json
say | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha "hi"
interrupt | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha
answer | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha yes
wait | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net alpha
hub status | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net --json
hub query | --server wss://hub.example.ts.net status
